verdict.rationale: CoreWeave relies on open, portable interfaces. Object storage is S3-compatible and objects can be downloaded from the Cloud Console. Clusters are standard Kubernetes reachable via kubeconfig/kubectl, infrastructure is defined in Terraform/OpenTofu, and billing usage can be exported through the FOCUS API (Public Preview). Together these imply you can pull data out in standard formats and move elsewhere, but the evidence never addresses exit or export explicitly. Missing for 10: a documented account-wide data export or offboarding process, information on egress costs or limits, export of non-object data such as volumes or inference configs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating off.
